exposure_matched_uncapped_control.interpretation: For selected profiles, normalize each recorded pre-cap target to the cap-constrained investment fraction determined at that same Open, then replay an unconstrained account on the same event dates. No subsequent realized-cash backscaling. This is an explanatory counterfactual conditioned on constrained-account event/target information, not an independently selected tradable strategy.
